name: Ketheric Thorm
appearance:
Ketheric has a severe, weathered look - his face marked by age and a permanent scowl. He wears a plain circlet adorned with the skull of Myrkul, and a richly detailed suit of armor which clearly identifies him as the Chosen of the Lord of Bones. His Netherstone rests securely in an ornate golden cage on his chest armour. Ketheric's straight gray hair is tucked neatly behind his slightly pointed ears. A thick, full beard connects to his hair, which suggests he has only partly elven ancestry (according to the Forgotten Realms lore elves, unlike half-elves, cannot grow facial hair).

Despite this, in the first vision imposed upon the party by the Absolute near the Goblin Camp, the Narrator calls him "a mighty elf" among the Chosen Three. The Elder Rothé in Grymforge, if spoken to via , also describes him in the same words. Companions' comments on murals surrounding Isobel's grave inside the Thorm Mausoleum (where the key points of Ketheric's story are depicted), too, refer to him as an elf.

Presumably, Ketheric was first planned to be an Elf but was later changed to half-elf, and the (likely) erroneous mentionings as an elf are oversights by the developers.
personality:
Though best described as a man tormented and utterly transformed by grief, his daughter Isobel speaks of a loving, doting father while she was growing up, one who had the admiration of his subjects for being just and fair, full of love for his wife who he adored more than anyone else. Tragedy, however, would turn him into a bitter, wrathful man, willing to cleanse Reithwin from any Selûnites to spite the Moonmaiden for abandoning him.

Whatever the man he once was, the Ketheric the party encounters is a callous one, evident by his dismissal of Minthara and the goblins, ordering their torture and execution for failing him. Though courteous when needed, he will quickly condemn the party to death should they defy his orders. Above all, however, he is ruthless and relentless in his pursuits, willing to burn the entire world just to be reunited with his daughter.

Though his loss and anguish moved him to change his patron god twice in search of relief, he proved to be an ardent believer of each while serving them: for Selûne, he built Moonrise Towers in her honour, for Shar, he built a grand temple under town in her name and for Myrkul, he amassed a great army ready to raze Baldur's Gate to the ground. 

Through it all, he kept close to him, showing that deep down a small part of him still remembers the man he once was.
backstory:
Risen from the grave a hundred years after the events that led to his downfall, Ketheric Thorm serves as the main antagonist of Act Two of the game, after being introduced during Act One through dialogue and in-game notes first. As the party members search for ways to cure their tadpole situation, many clues point towards Moonrise Towers and Ketheric himself and the party eventually must bring him down in order to rid the Shadow-Cursed Lands from its curse.

By exploring Moonrise Towers, through subsequent battle with him, and later exploring the Illithid colony under the stronghold, an elaborate conspiracy behind the tadpoles in the party members's heads is unveiled. Ketheric's alliance with Enver Gortash and Orin the Red is also exposed, along with his plans to secure all three Netherstones for himself. Also, during the fight against him it is revealed that it was Myrkul who brought Ketheric back from the dead.
